print_correction.difference: An enlarged comparison of the two printed spellings resolves the medial vowel in the first word as short. The XML reading and PG209 inflection selections are retained.

causative_perfect: The long/short grade remains in the main verb before ām. Kṛ, as and bhū conjugate in the active. Before a consonant the word-final anusvāra and its optional homorganic realization are both licensed by 8.4.59.
causative_aorist: Caṅ after ṇic, radical shortening, reduplication, san-like treatment and lengthening of the copy yield aśīśamat for both base histories. Ni plus aṭ gives nyaśīśamat. The first śī belongs to the copy.
source_status: All nine selected bare caṅ words and all non-anusvāra auxiliary spellings appear under 01.0929. The two prefixed schedules are inflectional analyses; the direct traditional citations concern the present.
